notes.key_messages: • Candidates showed that they were well prepared to manage the demands of this component in its new format. • In the longer questions, candidates respected the guidelines regarding length, producing approximately 80 words for Question 2 and, for Question 3, between 130–140 words. • The most successful answers focused clearly on the demands of the rubrics, were well structured and showed signs of thoughtful planning. • Candidates aiming for the highest grades could use a range of verb tenses, sentence structures, and more complex linguistic patterns. • Work was generally very well-presented and nearly always legible.
notes.general_comments: Work from the full ability range was seen. The gradient of difficulty in the questions allowed the vast majority of candidates to show what they knew and could do.
